1.title: Conditions on US aircraft carrier at sea for more than 250 days raise alarms
1.summary: Thousands of sailors on the USS Abraham Lincoln have reportedly faced food shortages and broken plumbing, with some considering jumping overboard.

2.title: Ex-Officer Held in New Orleans Mass Shooting Plot Is Freed Without Charges
2.summary: Law enforcement officials had said that Christopher Gillum, a former police officer in North Carolina, planned to attack a large festival. He was released without charges.

3.title: Judge Dismisses Trump Administration’s Antisemitism Case Against Harvard
3.summary: The government argued the university had not done enough to combat antisemitism during campus protests. A judge called the incidents “isolated and episodic.”

5.title: Engine parts smashed Ryanair window that man's head was sucked out of, report says
5.summary: A preliminary report by US investigators says an engine fan blade broke on last month's flight from Greece to Germany.

6.title: Train Derails Near Town of Lewes in East Sussex, U.K.
6.summary: Emergency services said they were working at the scene of a derailment near Lewes, in East Sussex, on Thursday. Eighteen other people were less badly hurt.
